title: Controllable flow matching synthesis for generalizable crack segmentation with a 50k image-mask benchmark (CrackSegFlow)
mechanism: Pixel-space flow-matching mask-to-image renderer with topology-preserving mask injection and boundary-gated modulation, plus a class-conditional mask generator and rectified-flow injection of a crack mask onto any crack-free background.
adaptation: 1-channel renderer trained on 256 px crops at native 512 scale from the 478 train cells only; condition on the crack mask (dilated to 3 px) plus a 5-source one-hot so it learns each source's line width and contrast; masks sampled from train crack masks with rotation/elastic/width changes; inject onto the 1,152 unlabelled multi half-cut pool cells and scuff-bearing cells so scuffs become hard negatives for E1.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + rendered pairs on half-cut pool cells (<=30% of batch), 5 seeds. Baseline: PF 5 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and recall@2; guard test crack IoU clean 49. Kill: E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 or test crack IoU drop > 0.01.
evidence: R: +5.37 mIoU / +5.13 F1 in-domain averaged over 5 crack sets with 16x synthetic pairs; CrackTree260 (1 px centreline labels, 400 train crops at 256 px) 38.2 -> 49.5 mIoU; target-guided cross-domain +13 mIoU / +14.7 F1; latent diffusion conditioning blurs or misaligns hairline cracks (qualitative). Trained on 2 A100.
prior_overlap: Partly overlaps CP100 (real crack components pasted onto pool cells, house model, n.d. on test). Still open: CP100 moved real crack pixels without adapting appearance, used no new shapes or widths, did not select half-cut/scuff backgrounds, was not scored for E1 as the primary metric, and used the house fine-tune, not PF.

alt_notes.adaptation: Train the renderer on our 209 crack cells; inject sampled crack masks into pool half-cells with scuff streaks, producing labelled half-cut + scuff crack cells, the exact E1 condition that training lacks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + 2,000 injected half-cells (+ real) vs PF, 3 seeds. Kill if E1 crack recall in scuff cells gains < +0.10 or test crack precision drops > 0.03.
